translation.title: Analgesic and Anti-inflammatory Plaster
translation.efficacy: This medicine is used for the analgesic and anti-inflammatory relief of sprains, bruises, muscle pain, joint pain, low back pain, stiff shoulders, neuralgia, and rheumatic pain.
translation.usage: Apply 1 to several patches a day to the affected area. If the affected area is wet with sweat or the like, wipe it dry before applying the patch.
translation.caution: Do not use this medicine in the following cases: infants under 30 months of age; eczema; dermatitis caused by lacquer or the like; wounded areas. Consult a doctor or pharmacist before using this medicine in the following cases: people who have experienced allergic symptoms (such as rash, redness, itching or dermatitis caused by lacquer) from medicines or cosmetics; people with an allergic constitution; people with severe moist skin or erosion; children. Follow the prescribed dosage and directions. When it is used by a child, use it under the supervision of a guardian. If your symptoms do not improve after 5 to 6 days of use, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. This medicine is for external use only. Do not warm the area where the patch is applied with a heater, an electric blanket or the like. Bathing with the patch on causes strong irritation, so remove it 30 minutes to 1 hour before bathing. Stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist if any of the following occur: rash; redness; itching; swelling; occasionally severe itching or pain. Store at room temperature, protected from moisture and light. Keep out of reach of children.
